name: NOON (NO)
fix_description: _transfer(address,address,uint256) (0x30e0789e) is exposed as public/external but should be internal. Anyone can call it to transfer tokens from any address to any address without authorization. Fix: change visibility to internal.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward exploit based on an obvious vulnerability pattern: a wrongly exposed internal-like _transfer function that lets the attacker move tokens out of the LP pair. The attack is only a few steps long (steal pair tokens, sync/update reserves, send tokens back, then swap for WETH) and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond basic Uniswap V2 reserve mechanics.
